$comment: An invented qualification manifest that uses every field the format has: what a commit must pass before anything ships it. A proof workflow evaluates it and sets the commit status named by status_context; status_meaning says exactly what success asserts. Evidence is a run with event push, in this repository, for the exact commit, on a branch matching evidence_branch_patterns: main, or a landing-queue branch queue/<n> whose tested commit main is then fast-forwarded to. A job passes only by succeeding: skipped passes only where listed in allow_skipped_jobs.
status_meaning: Commit status `qualified` with state success, set only by the proof workflow at main, means: this exact commit is on main, and for every workflow under `required` a push run of this exact commit in this repository, on main or on a landing-queue branch queue/<n>, completed with every job succeeded (skipped only where allow_skipped_jobs says). The status is a published signal, never a credential; qlander recomputes the verdict before it moves `release`.

allow_skipped_jobs.pr-only: An example of a job that runs on pull requests only.

required.name: Docs
required.why: An example path-filtered workflow: required when the push triggered it.

not_required..github/workflows/publish.yml: An example of a workflow left out: publishing is gated by qualification, so it cannot be an input to it.
